name: codesign
description: CoDesign gives AI agents like Claude Code, Codex and PI a real design engine for genuine, editable designs, not flat images. Bring in what you have: InDesign, Photoshop, PowerPoint and PDF files stay editable. Exports print PDFs (CMYK, bleed) and videos. Every design opens in a built-in editor for manual fixes. Runs on your machine, no account.

error_reports.title: Send error reports to IMG.LY
error_reports.description: Crash and internal-error reports: error type, a scrubbed message, stack frames, versions and OS. Never your prompts, files or designs.

usage_telemetry.title: Send usage data to IMG.LY
usage_telemetry.description: Anonymous counts of tool use. Turning this off also stops error reports.
